title: Etale logification with its normalized quotient presentation
statement: Let $X$ be locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and $P$ an etale prelog sheaf [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. There exist an etale log structure $L$ and a normalized sectionwise unit-pushout sheafification presentation $l$ [def-trf-prelog-logification-data] such that every structurally compatible prelog map $P\to K$ to an etale log structure extends uniquely along $l.\mathrm{iota}$ to a structurally compatible monoid-sheaf map $L\to K$.

source.place: ILO VIII, opening of section 3, p.97, and 3.3.2, p.106; arbitrary-prelog formulation and detailed proof expanded by the agent from the parent node.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-prelog-pushout-log-axiom]. Its surjective pair map has precisely the specified congruence as its kernel. The first isomorphism theorem for monoids therefore identifies the actual quotient with its presheaf value; transport the sheafification pair maps along these isomorphisms. To factor a natural family into a target sheaf, compose with their inverses and use the existing sheafification Hom bijection. Naturality and uniqueness are checked on exhaustive pair representatives. This supplies all fields of the normalized presentation.

source.place: ILO VIII, opening of section 3, p.97, and 3.3.2, p.106; arbitrary-prelog formulation and detailed proof expanded by the agent from the parent node.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-prelog-pushout-hom-extension] to these fields. Its unique monoid-sheaf extension and structural equality define the required subtype element. Uniqueness in the subtype follows from uniqueness of the underlying map.
